stories.title: Buscan impulsar polo de desarrollo para zona norte de Toluca

en.title: Seeking to promote development hub for northern Toluca area
en.summary: Mexico State's economic development secretary proposed a development initiative for the northern zone of Toluca. The proposal originates from the state government.

stories.title: Se inconforman por nuevas tarifas del Tren al AIFA

en.title: Complaints over new AIFA Train fares
en.summary: Users express dissatisfaction with fare increases to the airport train, with some claiming prices have doubled. Others consider the new rates acceptable compared to taxi costs.

en.title: "Plan will affect housing construction"
en.summary: The Real Estate Developers Association warns that a plan will increase land and project execution costs for housing development.

stories.title: Brugada presentará iniciativa de ley de rentas en informe

en.title: Brugada will present rental law initiative in report
en.summary: The governor will present a rental law initiative and an education reform proposal to Congress.

stories.title: Plan de ordenamiento es un “catálogo de alternativas” para gobiernos, dice Sedatu

en.title: Spatial Planning Plan is a "catalog of alternatives" for governments, says Sedatu
en.summary: A federal official indicates that the spatial planning plan offers options that governments may or may not adopt, including a proposal on property tax calculation that would not necessarily result in tax increases.

stories.title: Encuesta: Felifer Macías, el panista mejor posicionado hacia la gubernatura

en.title: Poll: Felifer Macías, the PAN candidate best positioned for the governorship
en.summary: A survey shows that Felifer Macías, the PAN mayor of Querétaro's capital, leads with 37.2% of voter intention, while his party ranks first with 34.8% overall support.

stories.title: El Metro de Nuevo León tiene la mayor expansión

en.title: The Nuevo León Metro has the largest expansion
en.summary: Lines 4 and 6 of the Nuevo León Metro will add 34 kilometers of new infrastructure, including an elevated viaduct monorail system, new stations, and specialized equipment.

stories.title: Exigen aclarar las detenciones en la marcha por agua contaminada en Jalisco; familias denuncian irregularidades

en.title: Demands to clarify detentions at march over contaminated water in Jalisco; families report irregularities
en.summary: Authorities released 32 of 39 people detained at a protest in Jalisco, though none were cleared of charges and investigations continue. Family members have alleged improper conduct during the arrests.

stories.title: Zombies a la mexicana en "Prefiero la muerte"

en.title: Mexican-style zombies in "Prefiero la muerte"
en.summary: A Prime Video series follows teenagers affected by an attack of undead creatures in a Mexican setting.

stories.title: Carlos Illades indaga en el primer socialismo

en.title: Carlos Illades investigates early socialism
en.summary: Historian Carlos Illades has published a new edition of a work on early socialism in Mexico, covering the period from the mid-19th century through more recent expressions.

stories.title: Deja 'Rachel' cuatro muertos en Ensenada; dos son niños

en.title: Hurricane Rachel leaves four dead in Ensenada; two are children
en.summary: Storm Rachel caused at least four deaths in Ensenada, including two children, while 32 people were rescued by air and search efforts continued.

stories.title: Tope a deducciones de empresas pasa al pleno de la Cámara de Diputados

en.title: Cap on business deductions advances to Chamber of Deputies plenary
en.summary: Deputies on the Finance Commission approved a government proposal modifying income tax law to strengthen anti-fraud measures and expand access to simplified tax regimes.

stories.title: Checo Pérez y la apuesta en un hotel de Mónaco que terminó en 18 años de patrocinio

en.title: Checo Pérez and the bet on a Monaco hotel that ended in 18 years of sponsorship
en.summary: Before joining Formula 1, Checo Pérez sought financial support to continue racing in Europe. A condition related to a Monaco hotel led to a long-term sponsorship relationship with Interprotección.

stories.title: Carlos Slim lleva otra empresa a la BMV; prepara debut de INCA en mercado accionario

en.title: Carlos Slim brings another company to the BMV; prepares INCA debut in stock market
en.summary: A company controlled by Carlos Slim will list on Mexico's stock exchange through a corporate spinoff from Grupo Financiero Inbursa rather than a traditional initial public offering.

stories.title: Diputados aprueban en Comisión alzas a cobros a turistas y al uso de vías férreas

en.title: Deputies approve in Commission increases in charges to tourists and railroad usage
en.summary: Mexico's congress committee approved raising fees for foreign migration rights and visas starting in 2027, with opposition lawmakers warning of potential negative impacts on tourism.

stories.title: Carlos Slim tiene casi 100 departamentos frente a Bellas Artes: el negocio que pasa inadvertido en la CDMX

en.title: Carlos Slim has almost 100 apartments facing Bellas Artes: the business that goes unnoticed in Mexico City
en.summary: Carlos Slim's Inmuebles Carso operates a residential development near Mexico City's Bellas Artes as part of a broader portfolio containing over 3,500 identifiable housing units across Mexico.
